sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia English set decorator Jill Quertier Born 1936 (age 89–90) Bromley, Kent , England Occupation Set decorator Jill Quertier (born 1936) is an English set decorator . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] She won an Academy Award in the category Best Production Design for the film Shakespeare in Love and was nominated for another for Quills .
